title: Point of sale
subtitle: Sell at the counter on your own shift.
notPosDevice: This PC is not enrolled as a point of sale. Sales at the counter work only on POS PCs.
drawerBusy: {name} has an open shift on this drawer. Only that cashier can sell here until the shift is closed.
dropDueLong: The drawer holds more cash than the limit. Please make a cash drop to the safe.
fullInvoice: Full tax invoice with the customer's TRN {trn}.
emptyCart: Choose a product from the list to start the sale.
discountLimitNote: Your discount limit without approval is 5%. Above it, or for a changed price, a supervisor approves.
noItems: No matching item. Try another name or scan the barcode.
linesInvalid: A line in the cart has a problem. Check the quantities and prices.
heldEmpty: No held carts on this PC.

line.priceNeedsSupervisor: A changed price needs a supervisor's approval.

lineProblem.decimals: This unit takes whole numbers only.

payment.title: Payment
payment.short: The amount received is less than the amount due.
payment.drawerOpens: The drawer opens after confirming and the receipt prints.
payment.chargeTerminal: Charge {amount} on the card terminal, then type the approval code from its slip.
payment.approvalCodeHint: Letters and digits from the terminal slip. Never type card numbers.

done.title: Paid

notPrinted.browser: Printing works in the Windows app only. This is the receipt as it will print:
notPrinted.no_printer: No receipt printer is chosen for this PC (Settings → Devices). The receipt:
notPrinted.failed: The printer did not respond. Check it and print again.

done.oversell: Sold beyond stock: adjustment {number} waits for the storekeeper's review.

discount_over_limit.title: Discount above the limit
discount_over_limit.explain: The discount is above the cashier's limit. A supervisor approves with their PIN.

price_override.title: Changed price
price_override.explain: A unit price different from the item's price needs a supervisor's approval.

credit_over_limit.title: Unpaid amount
credit_over_limit.explain: This customer pays cash or is above the credit limit. A supervisor approves leaving it unpaid.

oversell.title: Selling beyond stock
oversell.explain: Not enough stock. With a supervisor's approval the sale goes through and an oversell adjustment waits for the storekeeper's review.

issue.title: Return
issue.explain: A return needs a supervisor's approval. It makes a credit note linked to the invoice.

paid_out.title: Paid-out
paid_out.explain: Taking cash out of the drawer needs a supervisor's approval.

recount.title: Recount
recount.explain: One recount is allowed, with a supervisor's approval. Both counts are kept.

returns.title: Return at the POS
returns.notFound: No issued invoice with this number.
returns.notPos: This invoice was not sold at the POS. Use a credit note in Invoices (A4).
returns.needsSupervisor: A supervisor approves the return. Cash is paid back from the drawer of the shift open now; card payments go back to the card.
returns.chooseLines: Choose what comes back (not more than was sold).
returns.reasonRequired: Choose a reason and write the details.
returns.payFromDrawer: Pay the cash back from the drawer.

shiftOpen.title: Open the shift
shiftOpen.help: Count the float you take from the safe and type it. Only you sell on this drawer until you close the shift.
shiftOpen.noPermission: You may not open a shift.

shiftPage.title: My shift
shiftPage.subtitle: Shift {number}
shiftPage.noShift: No shift of yours is open on this PC.
shiftPage.closeHelp: Count the cash without seeing the expected amount. The difference shows after counting.

noSale.title: Open the drawer without a sale

closeShift.title: Close the shift — blind count
closeShift.blindHelp: Count every note and coin in the drawer. The expected amount appears after you save the count.
closeShift.otherHint: Cash that is not one of the listed notes or coins.

shifts.title: Shifts & cash
shifts.subtitle: Every shift with its over/short. The owner or the accountant accepts each difference.
shifts.acceptHelp: Shift {number} of {name}: difference {amount}. It posts to Cash over/short.
shifts.noteRequired: Write a short note (3 characters or more).

alert.cash_drop_due: A drawer holds more cash than the limit: a cash drop is due.
alert.repeated_variance: A cashier had {times} differences above the limit within {days} days.

newSaleHint: Scan a barcode or choose products to add them to the invoice.
fullInvoiceNote: A VAT-registered customer gets a full tax invoice with their TRN.
